review.title: What still needs owner or legal review
review.intro: The statements on this page describe the product as it is implemented. They are not a certification, and the items below are not settled by the software.
review.item1: No GDPR or other compliance certification is claimed, because none is implemented or evidenced in this product.
review.item2: No automatic deletion deadline is implemented. Any number of days must be confirmed by the owner before it is promised.
review.item3: No specific encryption algorithm, at-rest encryption, or security certification is claimed.
review.item4: A promise not to sell personal information, and the limits on advertising use, still need owner confirmation.
review.item5: Retention periods for billing records, technical logs, and backups are not fixed in the application.
review.item6: ValueOR cannot delete data that only Meta, a payment provider, or an email host stores.
review.item7: Children’s privacy, international transfers, warranties, and liability wording need legal review before they are treated as final.

privacy.retentionBody: Company workspace records remain until an authorized user deletes them in the product or ValueOR completes a reviewed deletion request. The application does not enforce a fixed retention period. Billing and payment records may be kept when accounting, a dispute, or a legal obligation requires it, but no retention length is configured here. Technical logs are used for security and operations; their exact lifetime needs owner confirmation. Backup copies, if the host keeps them, are outside this page.
privacy.securityBody: Company access is limited by sign-in, role permissions, and company membership. The public site is intended to be served over HTTPS by its host. This page does not claim a specific encryption algorithm, encryption at rest, or a security certification.
privacy.deletionBody: Where the product has a delete control, an authorized user can delete that record. There is no automatic wipe of a company workspace. Anyone can email a deletion request from the Data Deletion page. ValueOR reviews that request manually. The product does not implement a completion deadline.
privacy.contactBody: For privacy questions or a deletion request, email {{email}} or use mobile {{phone}}. You can also open the Data Deletion page. Do not include passwords or access tokens.
privacy.metaNoSell: The product does not include a feature that sells personal information. Treating that as a binding promise still needs owner confirmation.
privacy.metaNoAds: Customer message content is used to operate the channels a company has connected. A formal restriction on advertising use still needs owner confirmation.
privacy.childrenBody: ValueOR is a business workspace and does not include a children’s account. Whether a children’s-privacy rule applies needs legal confirmation.
privacy.internationalBody: Hosting and connected providers may process data outside the country where the company operates. The product does not implement a separate transfer agreement. Any cross-border safeguard needs legal confirmation.

dataDeletion.requestBody: There is no self-serve wipe of a company workspace on this page. Email {{email}} or call {{phone}}. Use the subject “ValueOR data deletion request” so the message can be recognized.
dataDeletion.afterBody: ValueOR reviews the request manually and may ask for enough detail to match it to an account or a company. The product does not delete data automatically and does not enforce a number of days. Some records may be kept for a legal, security, or financial reason; the exact list is not defined in the software and needs owner confirmation. Data stored only by Meta, a payment provider, or an email host is not deleted by this page.

terms.contactBody: Questions about these Terms can be sent to {{email}} or {{phone}}.
terms.liabilityBody: ValueOR is provided as the software currently operates. This page is not a warranty and it is not a cap on liability that has been reviewed by counsel. Those terms need legal confirmation before they are treated as final.
terms.availabilityBody: The service can be interrupted by hosting, database, or third-party channel outages. Features can change. These Terms can be updated on this page. No uptime percentage is promised.
